pages.title: The Fletcher
pages.text: The village $(l)Fletcher$() deals in this mod's gear: it no longer sells vanilla bows.$(br)$(li)$(l)Novice$(): modular arrows$(li)$(l)Apprentice$(): Flax String, and a $(l)Modular Bow$()$(li)$(l)Journeyman$(): a $(l)Modular Crossbow$()$(li)$(l)Expert / Master$(): $(l)enchanted$() versions of both

Every weapon it sells comes $(l)fully assembled with random parts$(), tuned somewhere between 55% and 90%.$(br2)So a bought bow is a solid find, but a careful run at the $(l)Fletching Table$() still out-tunes it. Buying is convenience, not the best gear.

pages.title: The Shepherd
pages.text: The $(l)Shepherd$() works raw fibre:$(br)$(li)$(l)Novice$(): buy $(l)Flax$() for an emerald$(li)$(l)Apprentice$(): sell your surplus flax back$(br2)$(o)A villager's trades are set when it takes its profession: an old villager keeps its old trades.$()
